title: ADR-0087: no disposition category names a member removed from a hook's return when its interface is not exported
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (a gate admits a disposition its own ADR says to refuse) · Source: fleet (contract review record 7216271239 on PR #37883, nit N1, escalated to the seat)

## What happens

PR #37883 (Part of #37575) removes `appContentLanguages` from what `useObjectTranslation()` and `useI18nContext()` return in the published `@object-ui/i18n`. The member sits on `I18nContextValue`, which the package does not export, and on the hooks' inferred return types.

- `runtime-export-retired` addresses a member only through an exported type (`<package>#<Type>.<member>`), so it cannot name this one.
- `runtime-interface-only` and `type-surface-only` take a path symbol and do not fit a member of an inferred hook return.
- The PR therefore carries `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, while its changeset body does prescribe a migration ("use `useAppContentLanguages()` instead"). ADR-0087 (the `no-migration-prescription` paragraph) says that category is refused by such a body. `check:adr-0087-registration` admits it only because its detector reads arrows and framed tables, not a sentence.

The outcome on #37883 is right: no ledger entry is owed, because nothing an author writes in metadata changes. The vocabulary has no true category for it.

## Expected

- [ ] Either a category (or an addressing form of an existing one) that names a member of a published hook's return when its interface is unexported, re-verified like the others; or a written ruling that `no-migration-prescription` with a prose prescription is right for this shape, and the ADR text says so.
- [ ] The gate and the ADR agree on whether a prose prescription refuses `no-migration-prescription`.

`docs/adr/**` is governed: the ADR amendment needs the maintainer's word.

Grade: area:fleet · domain:devx · reach: the breaking-change disposition gate · evidence: the record above, ADR-0087 :745-780 on `main`
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: S
Related: PR #37883, #37575, #37447 (a sibling vocabulary gap: a member kept with its type changed).
